1. Supervision & transitions 监管与活动转换

FL-0001 · CORE-0001 · FAM-001 · center · DRAFT

门口交接 — 即时处理
Doorway handoff — Immediate response

Mia已把Leo标为接收，Jordan却没有回应交接。处理时孩子仍需要看护。同事说：“先填完记录，实际安排待会儿再改。”

Mia marks Leo received, but Jordan has not answered the handoff. The children still need supervision while staff address the issue. A coworker says, “Finish the paperwork first; we can change the arrangement afterward.”

作为园长，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？

As director, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? How would you divide the work now and prevent the response itself from leaving children unsupervised?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

Mia说清：“Jordan，现在把Leo交给你。”等Jordan明确回应，再按接收名单核对Leo。交接完成前，Mia继续负责。

Mia should say, “Jordan, you have Leo now,” and wait for Jordan to reply, “I have Leo.” Check Leo against the receiving list. Mia remains responsible until the handoff is complete.

实务处理 / Practical approach

附近有成人，不代表对方知道自己已经接手照看。 先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。

An adult nearby may not know that responsibility has changed. Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.

记录与最佳实践 / Records and best practice

保留“门口交接”的实际观察、行动、负责人和结果。保留原条目，分清已知与未知，更正用实际日期，不为填完整而编造事实。

Keep the actual observations, action, responsible person and result for “Doorway handoff”. Preserve the original entry, distinguish what is known from what is uncertain, and use the actual date for a correction. Do not invent a fact to complete the record.

待确认事项 / Items to verify

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证监管、活动转换与出勤程序。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 依赖法律结论前，先确认实际许可类别、年龄、岗位和项目。

Confirm the actual license category, ages, role and program before relying on a legal conclusion.

FL-0002 · CORE-0002 · FAM-001 · home · DRAFT

门口交接 — 独自工作
Doorway handoff — Working alone

Mia要用相邻房间，现场可帮忙的住户却未确认照护资格。平时获准的备用人员不在。经营者需要判断哪些事情可以推迟，以及实际住宅布局能否继续支持安全照护。

Mia needs the adjoining room; the only available household adult has no confirmed care role. The usual approved backup is not available. The provider must decide what can be postponed and whether safe care can continue in the actual home layout.

作为家庭托育负责人，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？哪些能自己做，哪些可以等，什么时候需要启用允许的备用或应变安排？

As the family child-care provider, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? What can you do yourself, what can wait, and when would you need the permitted backup or contingency plan?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

继续负责这个孩子和全组。没有已核实合格人员明确接手，就不让孩子独自进入另一房间。使用可安全照看的获准区域，不能继续安全照护时启用允许的应变安排。

Keep responsibility for the child and group. Do not send the child through the doorway without a verified eligible person clearly accepting care. Use the safe approved area and the permitted contingency plan if safe care cannot continue.

实务处理 / Practical approach

附近有成人，不代表对方知道自己已经接手照看。 你继续负责孩子，推迟不紧急的冲突任务，只使用已核实获准的备用人员。实际条件不能支持安全照护时，按应变安排处理，不假设有一个现成帮手。

An adult nearby may not know that responsibility has changed. Keep responsibility for the children, pause non-urgent competing tasks and use only a verified permitted backup. If the actual setting cannot support safe care, use the appropriate contingency process rather than inventing an available helper.

FL-0291 · CORE-0291 · FAM-030 · center · DRAFT

在园期间生病 — 即时处理
Illness while in care — Immediate response

孩子生病时，全组仍需积极照看。处理时孩子仍需要看护。同事说：“先填完记录，实际安排待会儿再改。”

A child becomes ill while the group needs active care. The children still need supervision while staff address the issue. A coworker says, “Finish the paperwork first; we can change the arrangement afterward.”

作为园长，怎样同时照顾患儿、看护全组，并处理家长不能立即接回的情况？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？

As director, how would you care for the ill child, supervise the group and manage delayed pickup? How would you divide the work now and prevent the response itself from leaving children unsupervised?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

让患病儿童在舒适处有人照看，同时安排其他儿童的看护，并按计划联系家庭。

Keep the ill child comfortably supervised, arrange care for the rest of the group, and contact the family under the illness plan. Do not leave the child alone in a separate room.

实务处理 / Practical approach

把患病儿童分开照顾，也不能让其无人看护。 先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。

Separating an ill child must not leave that child unattended. Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.

Outdated contact list — Working alone

独自经营者联系不上名单备用接送人。平时获准的备用人员不在。经营者需要判断哪些事情可以推迟，以及实际住宅布局能否继续支持安全照护。

A lone provider cannot reach the listed pickup backup. The usual approved backup is not available. The provider must decide what can be postponed and whether safe care can continue in the actual home layout.

作为家庭托育负责人，怎样更新联系人并测试可用的备用方法，而不把紧急热线当练习电话？哪些能自己做，哪些可以等，什么时候需要启用允许的备用或应变安排？

As the family child-care provider, how would you update the contact information and test a workable backup without using an emergency line for practice? What can you do yourself, what can wait, and when would you need the permitted backup or contingency plan?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

通过日常程序请家庭确认号码，测试约定的备用联系方法，不向紧急热线作练习拨号。

Ask families to confirm contact details through the program's normal process. Test the backup communication system using an agreed non-emergency contact.

实务处理 / Practical approach

号码过时，可能在最需要时打不通。 你继续负责孩子，推迟不紧急的冲突任务，只使用已核实获准的备用人员。实际条件不能支持安全照护时，按应变安排处理，不假设有一个现成帮手。

An outdated number may fail precisely when time matters most. Keep responsibility for the children, pause non-urgent competing tasks and use only a verified permitted backup. If the actual setting cannot support safe care, use the appropriate contingency process rather than inventing an available helper.

记录与最佳实践 / Records and best practice

保留“应急联系表过时”的实际观察、行动、负责人和结果。保留原条目，分清已知与未知，更正用实际日期，不为填完整而编造事实。

Keep the actual observations, action, responsible person and result for “Outdated contact list”. Preserve the original entry, distinguish what is known from what is uncertain, and use the actual date for a correction. Do not invent a fact to complete the record.

分别保存每位目击者的事实陈述，注明未知情况，不等意见一致才提供照护或作已要求的报告。

Different accounts do not justify rewriting history or delaying care. Keep each original account and separate observations, reported information and unknown facts. 代班收到带侮辱性的管教话术。今天稍后要交接责任。接手人员拿到了平时日程，却没有收到本问题和现有防护的清楚说明。

A substitute is handed an insulting discipline script. Responsibility will change later today. The incoming worker has the ordinary schedule but has not received a clear account of this issue or the safeguards currently in place.

作为家庭托育负责人，你会怎样停止羞辱，并教孩子一个安全替代行为？交接前，代班人员必须能说清什么、找到什么？

As the family child-care provider, how would you stop the humiliating approach and teach a safe alternative? Before responsibility changes, what must the substitute be able to explain and find?

停止羞辱，用平静具体的话说明安全界限，并帮助儿童练习合适行为。

Stop the humiliating response. Say, “I will help you keep everyone safe,” then guide the child toward a safe action instead of shaming them.

实务处理 / Practical approach

羞辱儿童，不能教会下一步安全行为。 交代本事件、现有防护、必要的儿童个人说明和未决事项。请代班人员说出下一步并找到相关记录，再明确交接；实际岗位资格另行核实。

Shaming a child does not teach the next safe action. Brief the substitute on this event, the current safeguard, necessary child-specific instructions and any unresolved decision. Have them explain the next action and locate the relevant record before a clear handoff. Verify their actual role separately.

FL-0781 · CORE-0781 · FAM-079 · center · DRAFT

与动物互动 — 即时处理
Animal interaction — Immediate response

动物接触未查健康和处理方式。处理时孩子仍需要看护。同事说：“先填完记录，实际安排待会儿再改。”

Animal contact is planned without health or handling checks. The children still need supervision while staff address the issue. A coworker says, “Finish the paperwork first; we can change the arrangement afterward.”

作为园长，接触动物前，要完成哪些健康、接触、卫生和个人需要检查？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？

As director, what health, handling, hygiene and individual-needs checks would you complete before animal contact? How would you divide the work now and prevent the response itself from leaving children unsupervised?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

未审查前先分开动物与儿童，再安排安全接触、监督和洗手，考虑儿童个人需要。

Keep the animal separate until the activity has been checked. Plan safe handling, supervision, and handwashing, and account for the children's individual needs.

实务处理 / Practical approach

接触动物需要处理方式、卫生和个人需要安排。 先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。

Animal contact needs a plan for handling, hygiene and individual needs. Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.

家庭要求把记录做成按时完成。提出请求的人希望马上得到答复，说：“今天能不能先通融？”对方没有提供新的批准依据或安全资料。

A family asks staff to make the record look timely. The person asking wants an immediate answer and says, “Can we make an exception just for today?” No supporting approval or new safety information has been provided.

作为园长，怎样记录实际完成和发现日期，并处理剩余危险？你会怎样解释，并提供什么替代安排，而不承诺未经核实的例外？

As director, how would you record the real completion and discovery dates and address any remaining risk? What would you explain, and what alternative could you offer without promising an unverified exception?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

如实记实际完成和发现日期，处理剩余危险，不倒签，也不把补填清单当成已及时检查。

Record when the task was actually done and when the missed step was discovered. Address any remaining risk; a truthful late entry does not make an undone check timely.

实务处理 / Practical approach

如实补记，也不能让漏做事项变成按时完成。 平静说明这次具体顾虑，提供本事件可行的安全安排。不便或同意，都不能证明法律上确有例外。

A truthful late entry does not make a missed action happen on time. Explain the specific concern calmly and offer the safe option identified for this event. Do not turn inconvenience or consent into proof that a legal exception exists.

记录与最佳实践 / Records and best practice

保留“倒签清单”的实际观察、行动、负责人和结果。保留原条目，分清已知与未知，更正用实际日期，不为填完整而编造事实。

Keep the actual observations, action, responsible person and result for “Backdated checklist”. Preserve the original entry, distinguish what is known from what is uncertain, and use the actual date for a correction. Do not invent a fact to complete the record.

待确认事项 / Items to verify

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证政策维护、责任、记录诚信与规则更新规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 依赖法律结论前，先确认实际许可类别、年龄、岗位和项目。
